orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Concord Long-Burn Drive Mk2, a hull mount (outward is up): Mk1 plus pale-blue collar rings on the bell, regenerative cooling tubes up both flanks, a second band on each drum; inside a blue ring round the fuel-efficiency dial and a second small dial where the feed pipes were. Damaged: the bell lip dented and hanging, the bell cracked and sputtering, a cooling tube kinked, the right drum weeping pale fuel, the dial glass cracked, lamps red, sparks. Disabled: the bell bent over at the neck, a drum split and slid off, a cooling tube snapped, the dials dead, the repair hatch popped. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
